feature: Ground truth graph loader with JIRA client and coverage report
problem: The five-dimension eval requires mapping bug-inducing commits to fixing commits to JIRA issues. The replication zip contains commit_links_{PROJECT}.csv and {PROJECT}.csv files that form this chain, but they need extraction, indexing, and validation. JIRA metadata (eval-only) needs a cached client.
proposed_solution: GroundTruthGraph class that extracts and indexes linkage from the replication zip. JiraClient with httpx + disk cache. Coverage report CLI that validates chain completeness per project and split.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: src/commit_investigator/ground_truth.py exists with GroundTruthGraph class
AC-2: GroundTruthGraph.from_replication_zip(path) extracts commit_links_{PROJECT}.csv and {PROJECT}.csv from zip without full extraction to disk
AC-3: GroundTruthGraph.get_fix_commits(bug_hash) returns list of fix hashes that fixed the given bug-inducing commit
AC-4: GroundTruthGraph.get_bug_commits(fix_hash) returns list of bug hashes that the fix addresses
AC-5: GroundTruthGraph.get_issue_keys(commit_id) returns JIRA issue keys linked to a commit
AC-6: GroundTruthGraph.get_chain(bug_hash) returns full chain: {bug_hash, fix_hashes, issue_keys}
AC-7: GroundTruthGraph exposes projects property listing all loaded projects
AC-8: src/commit_investigator/jira_client.py exists with JiraClient class using httpx
AC-9: JiraClient.get_issue(issue_key) fetches from https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issue/{key} and returns summary, description, priority, components, resolution
AC-10: JiraClient caches responses to disk (JSON files under configurable cache_dir, default data/jira_cache/)
AC-11: JiraClient returns cached response without network call on second fetch of same issue
AC-12: src/commit_investigator/coverage.py exists with coverage_report() function
AC-13: coverage_report() computes per-project: total buggy commits, commits with fix linkage, commits with issue linkage, chain completeness percentage
AC-14: coverage_report() validates against train/test CSVs: reports how many buggy=True rows have entries in the ground truth graph
AC-15: python -m commit_investigator.coverage --zip data/apachejit/apachejit_dataset_replication.zip --train data/apachejit/apachejit_train.csv runs without error and prints a summary table

AC-16: All new modules importable: python -c 'from commit_investigator.ground_truth import GroundTruthGraph; from commit_investigator.jira_client import JiraClient; from commit_investigator.coverage import coverage_report'
edge_cases: EC-1: GroundTruthGraph handles commits that appear in train CSV but have no entry in commit_links (clean commits) — returns empty lists, not errors
EC-2: JiraClient handles HTTP errors (404, 429, 500) gracefully with retry logic or informative error
EC-3: commit_links CSV has duplicate bug_hash entries (one bug fixed by multiple commits) — all fix hashes are captured
EC-4: {PROJECT}.csv may link multiple issues to same commit — all issue keys captured
verification_method: Evaluator runs: import checks, instantiates GroundTruthGraph from real zip, queries known commits, runs coverage CLI, verifies JIRA client cache behavior with mock/real call.
